note: Geotransform coefficients and pixel/line query points only. No computed world coordinates, no outcome labels, and no scoring key of any kind are included; nothing was run to produce this file. Query points are inputs for a later root-qualified witness, not results.

geotransforms.description: Unit pixel size, no rotation terms, north-up (gt[5] negative). The 2x2 block is diagonal by construction.
Projected-CRS-style origin in metres with 10 m pixels, north-up; ordinary large-offset case.
Geographic coordinates in degrees; small pixel sizes relative to the origin offsets.
Equal axis scales with gt[2] and gt[4] chosen as a nonzero antisymmetric pair: a rotated raster, not north-up.
Unequal axis scales with a non-antisymmetric off-diagonal pair, so the 2x2 block columns are non-orthogonal by construction (shear).
2x2 block columns constructed nearly parallel (off-diagonals 0.999999 against unit diagonals); sensitivity of the inverse is the property under review.
Both 2x2 block columns identical by construction, so the coefficient matrix is rank-deficient (zero determinant by construction).
All scale and rotation coefficients zero; every query maps onto the single point (gt[0], gt[3]) and the 2x2 block is the zero matrix.
